tagline: Leading global manufacturer of heavy-duty trucks, construction equipment, buses, and industrial engines with strong focus on electrification and sustainable transport solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: Adjusted operating margin of 11.0% in Q1 2026 demonstrates the group's operational resilience despite a 9% decline in sales, reflecting enhanced cost control efficiency and strong service segment performance amid energy transition headwinds.

kpis.name: Adjusted Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Adjusted operating profit before exceptional items, expressed as a percentage of net sales.
kpis.description: Adjusted operating margin reflects Volvo Group's resilient underlying performance in industrial operations, excluding exceptional impacts.
kpis.signal: Operating margin stable despite volume decline, supported by service segment improvement and cost control.

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated from product and service sales across the group.
kpis.description: Volvo Group net sales reached SEK 110.8 billion in Q1 2026, down from Q1 2025 primarily due to lower vehicle volumes, partially offset by strong 6% service segment growth.
kpis.signal: Sales down 9% but positive 2% organic growth driven by services.

kpis.name: Operating Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash flow generated from operating activities of industrial operations.
kpis.description: Operating cash flow from industrial operations amounted to SEK 0.4 billion in Q1 2026, impacted by normal seasonal working capital build-up.
kpis.signal: Reduced operating cash flow due to seasonal working capital strengthening.

kpis.name: Return on Capital Employed
kpis.explanation: Return generated on capital employed in industrial operations on a trailing 12-month basis.
kpis.description: Return on capital employed in industrial operations reached 24.5% on a trailing 12-month basis in Q1 2026, down from 31.8% year-ago primarily due to negative FX effects.
kpis.signal: ROCE down but still solid, reflecting currency impacts and normalization following an exceptional prior period.

kpis.name: Trucks Order Intake
kpis.explanation: Number of heavy-duty trucks ordered during the period, a key indicator of future demand.
kpis.description: Trucks order intake increased 14% to 62,755 vehicles, reflecting improved customer confidence and growing demand in Europe and the Americas.
kpis.signal: Strong 14% growth in trucks order intake, with increased demand in North and South America and progressive growth in Europe.

kpis.name: Truck Deliveries
kpis.explanation: Number of heavy-duty trucks delivered during the period.
kpis.description: Truck deliveries totaled 47,504 units in Q1 2026, down 3% due to production shutdowns in North America, partially offset by strong delivery pace in Europe.
kpis.signal: Truck deliveries slightly down due to production shutdown weeks in North America.

kpis.name: Trucks Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating margin for the trucks segment, showing profitability of road transport activities.
kpis.description: Volvo Trucks segment operating margin stood at 10.1% in Q1 2026, stable versus 10.3% year-ago, supported by 7% service segment growth.
kpis.signal: Trucks segment operating margin stable, maintained by service growth despite vehicle sales decline.

kpis.name: Construction Equipment Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating margin for the Volvo Construction Equipment segment.
kpis.description: Volvo Construction Equipment segment operating margin improved to 13.6% in Q1 2026, reflecting 14% organic growth and strong service performance across all key geographic markets.
kpis.signal: Significant improvement in construction equipment segment margin, driven by 14% organic growth and service sales expansion.

kpis.name: Buses Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating margin for the Volvo Buses segment.
kpis.description: Volvo Buses segment operating margin improved to 8.8% in Q1 2026 from 6.6% year-ago, reflecting 11% organic growth despite weaker demand in certain key markets.
kpis.signal: Notable improvement in buses segment operating margin, supported by 11% organic growth.

kpis.name: Volvo Penta Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating margin for the Volvo Penta engines segment.
kpis.description: Volvo Penta operating margin improved to 19.8% in Q1 2026 from 18.3% year-ago, reflecting 13% organic growth, strong capacity utilization, and expansion of power generation services.
kpis.signal: Strong Volvo Penta segment performance with elevated and improving operating margin, supported by 13% organic growth.

kpis.name: Net Financial Position
kpis.explanation: Net cash position of industrial operations, excluding pension obligations and lease contracts.
kpis.description: Net financial position of industrial operations stood at SEK 56.8 billion in Q1 2026, down from SEK 77.9 billion year-ago, primarily due to extraordinary dividend payment in April 2026.
kpis.signal: Solid net cash position but declining, affected by dividend payments and normalization following exceptional prior-year results.

kpis.name: Earnings Per Share
kpis.explanation: Net profit attributable to each ordinary share.
kpis.description: EPS stood at SEK 4.09 in Q1 2026, down 16% from SEK 4.86 year-ago, reflecting lower net income affected by negative FX impacts.
kpis.signal: EPS down due to lower net income and FX impacts.

ai_positioning.summary: Volvo is progressively integrating artificial intelligence in its vehicles and industrial processes, notably for driver assistance and production optimization. Focus is on practical applications and sustainable mobility solutions rather than radical innovations.
evidence: Deployment of advanced driver assistance systems in new Volvo FH, FM, and FMX Electric lineup
Launch of Volvo FH Aero Electric with extended range up to 700 km
Use of AI for production optimization and predictive maintenance in factories
Technology partnerships for embedded software development and autonomous driving solutions
